baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causal construction links aversion to the divinely delivered object with the collapse of their purposeful acts.
baseline_models.mechanism: Aversion is a reception gate rather than an incidental feeling: a directed delivery reaches the recipients, their evaluative refusal blocks incorporation, and the acts produced from that stance lose footing and result.

activation_trace.role: Repugnance opposed to willing acceptance supplies the rejecting stance and makes evaluation the gate in the mechanism.
Causing something to descend and reach another supplies directed delivery rather than an abstract idea.
Downward collapse supplies the loss of standing and outcome assigned to the deeds.
Intentional action supplies the affected output, so the verse concerns purposive efficacy rather than mere motion.

changed_reading.before: They dislike what God sent, and their deeds are then separately cancelled.
changed_reading.after: Their evaluative refusal of what reaches them from God is itself a condition by which purposeful action loses standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence joins hard refusal, divine placement, downward collapse, and the operation of deeds.
baseline_models.mechanism: What descends can be heard as something put into its fitting station. Rigid refusal resists that ordering, so activity may continue operationally while dropping out of the place in which it could remain valid.

activation_trace.role: Personal stiffness and hard-headed resistance supply rigidity against reordering.
Putting a thing into its proper station supplies an ordering function for the delivered material.
Falling from position supplies the consequence of resisting the offered order.
Putting an instrument, mind, or speech to work supplies continuing operation that need not equal valid placement.

changed_reading.before: A later penalty erases otherwise freestanding deeds.
changed_reading.after: Refusal dislocates active deeds from the delivered order that would give them a viable place.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The rare material branches of the causative collapse verb attach directly to the fate of purposeful deeds.
baseline_models.mechanism: The affected work can remain outwardly enlarged while becoming internally nonviable. The verse may therefore deny that visible volume, exertion, or impressive form proves that an act is nourishing or alive.

activation_trace.role: Repellent reception supplies the adverse relation to what should have been taken in.
Provision prepared for a recipient supplies the potential nourishment side of the analogy.
Livestock swelling after harmful forage supplies apparent fullness that approaches ruin rather than health.
An inflated outward form sharpens the distinction between impressive appearance and viable interior.
Purposeful acts are the body of output whose visible size can conceal terminal failure.

changed_reading.before: Invalidated deeds simply disappear from an account.
changed_reading.after: Deeds may remain visibly large yet be swollen, non-nourishing output already near collapse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Descent, the loss of a well's water, and hand-work coexist in the focus-root inventories.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful production is imagined as a worked water source dependent on replenishment from above. Refusing what descends severs that replenishment, leaving the constructed source present but unable to yield again.

activation_trace.role: Descent that includes rain and settlement supplies replenishment from above.
Aversive refusal supplies the severing relation to the incoming source.
A well whose water departs and does not return supplies loss of productive yield without removal of the structure.
People working by hand in digging and construction supply the made productive system.

changed_reading.before: The deeds are erased as objects.
changed_reading.after: The work-structure remains, but its sustaining source is withdrawn and it can no longer yield.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same kind of directed delivery sits inside an opposite process in 47:2: acceptance accompanies sound action, covered failures, and repair of the inner condition. The focus verse becomes the reverse branch of one reception process, collapse rather than repair.

activation_trace.role: Repugnance supplies the focus verse's negative reception pole.
A delivered object reaching its recipient supplies the matched input on the accepted side.
Restoration against corruption supplies the constructive outcome paired with accepted reception.
Covering an offense so its effect is removed supplies preservation of the actor rather than loss of work.
Soundness and ease of inner condition supply the repaired state that contrasts with collapse.
Collapse supplies the focus verse's opposite outcome.

structural_cues: 47:2 binds accepted delivery, sound action, covered failures, and repaired inner condition; 47:9 binds aversion to delivered material and collapsed action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched delivery with opposite repair and collapse outcomes; I infer that reception selects the process branch. A live alternative is that these are separate verdicts with no shared causal physiology.

changed_reading.before: The focus verse gives an isolated punishment for dislike.
changed_reading.after: It gives the negative branch of a reception system: accepted delivery repairs actor and action, while aversive delivery collapses action.

context_deltas.mechanism: Support stabilizes feet, whereas the opposing sequence stumbles and loses the direction of its works. The focus collapse is therefore also a failed trajectory: acts do not arrive at their intended end because their walkers cannot keep footing on the offered way.

activation_trace.role: Downward falling supplies the trajectory's collapse.
Strengthening something into stability supplies the positive condition for continued movement.
The physical foot supplies the carrier of the path mechanism.
A stumble and face-first fall without recovery supplies the opposed movement state.
Deviation from guidance and intended direction supplies failure to arrive.
Purposeful acts are explicitly the outputs whose route is lost.

structural_cues: 47:7-9 places stabilized feet, unrecoverable stumbling, misdirected works, and collapsed works in immediate succession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies feet, stabilization, stumbling, misdirection, and repeated works; I infer that deeds inherit the walker's trajectory. The live alternative is a purely juridical cancellation with movement imagery only framing the actors.

changed_reading.before: Their completed acts are removed after the fact.
changed_reading.after: Their acts lose the stable path by which intention could reach a valid result, so collapse is failed arrival as well as lost credit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Bad work is made attractive and desire is followed. This makes aversion to the delivered material one side of an inverted valuation system: attraction to embellished output generates repulsion from the standard that would expose it, and collapse strips the output's impressive surface of viability.

activation_trace.role: Repugnance supplies the negative evaluation of the delivered standard.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the positive but deceptive evaluation of bad output.
Objective badness and defect supply the condition hidden by adornment.
Purposeful work is the very object whose badness is beautified.
Following behind a guide supplies behavior organized by the preferred object.
The soul's inclination supplies the internal vector behind that following.
Inflated outward form supplies an appearance that can be enlarged while internally malformed.

structural_cues: 47:14 directly joins beautified bad work to following inclinations, turning the focus verse's dislike into part of a two-sided preference system.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beautification, bad work, inclination, and following; I infer that attraction to the bad output helps cause rejection of its corrective measure. The alternative is that adornment and aversion are parallel symptoms of a prior stance.

changed_reading.before: They happen not to like the delivered message.
changed_reading.after: They hate the corrective standard because an inverted appetite has made defective work look desirable; collapse exposes its swollen surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: Delivered speech reaches the acoustic channel but does not become understanding, reflection, or action: hearing is followed by baffled departure, the inner organ is sealed, apertures are stopped, and deliberation meets a lock. Collapsed work is the output failure of a closed reception pipeline.

activation_trace.role: Directed delivery supplies the input attempting to reach recipients.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the conversion that fails despite acoustic exposure.
A sealing stamp supplies closure of the receiving surface.
The heart supplies the inner organ on which reception should become orientation.
A stopped aperture with no gap supplies a stronger image of blocked entry.
Considering an affair through its outcome supplies the reflective transformation that is refused.
Closure, hardness, and dryness supply the final lock in the pipeline.
Purposeful action supplies the output that cannot form coherently when reception stays closed.

structural_cues: 47:16 stages listening, departure, and immediate failure to retain the saying; 47:23-24 extends the closure through deafness and locked hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence from hearing through sealed heart to failed deliberation; I infer a blocked input-to-action pipeline. A live alternative is that the closures are consequences of prior rejection rather than mechanisms producing collapsed work.

changed_reading.before: Aversion is a conscious opinion about already understood content.
changed_reading.after: Aversion also operates as closure that prevents delivered speech from becoming retained understanding and purposive output.

context_deltas.mechanism: A requested delivery becomes firm and names costly action; diseased hearts then become death-still. The next verse contrasts acceptable speech with the moment the matter is resolved. Aversion is thus exposed at the threshold where language must become committed work.

activation_trace.role: Repeated causing-to-descend supplies the requested input when it becomes concrete.
Firm construction and exactness supply the delivery's non-negotiable decisiveness.
Weakening an affair and constraining movement supplies incapacity at the action threshold.
Stillness and extinguished motion supply the death-like freeze when implementation is named.
Compliant yielding supplies the professed or demanded positive response.
The heart's resolved binding of an affair supplies the conversion point from words to action.
Making a promise true in deed supplies the implementation that would preserve the work.
Collapse supplies the result when speech never crosses the commitment threshold.

structural_cues: 47:20 moves from requesting a delivery to recoiling when it specifies fighting; 47:21 immediately names obedience, resolved matter, and truthfulness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, decisiveness, weakened motion, death-like gaze, resolve, and truthfulness; I infer that work aborts between acceptable speech and costly commitment. The alternative is situational fear that does not explain every instance of aversion.

changed_reading.before: They reject the message at the level of belief.
changed_reading.after: Their rejection becomes visible when delivered language hardens into a costly decision and professed obedience must become work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reversal occurs after guidance has become clear, under beautifying suggestion and extended delay. The wound-relapse branch of collapse becomes newly apt: work may have reached apparent closure, then reopen and retain the trace of a failed recovery.

activation_trace.role: A wound that relapses after healing and leaves marks supplies reversal after apparent repair.
Turning back after prior adherence supplies explicit rollback rather than initial absence.
Manifest disclosure supplies the prior clarity from which reversal occurs.
Internal or satanic beautification supplies the pressure that makes rollback attractive.
Extended time supplies delay in which the reversal can mature.
The split root's prolonging respite independently reinforces deferred rather than instantaneous failure.

structural_cues: 47:25 explicitly places turning back after clarified guidance; guidance supplies sequence structure here without requiring an additional branch citation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies clarity, rollback, beautifying suggestion, and respite; I infer a relapse process that damages already-forming work. The alternative is a clean juridical apostasy event with no gradual reopening mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The collapsed deeds never possessed any prior orientation or viability.
changed_reading.after: Some deeds may be post-clarity work that relapses under embellished delay, leaving the marks of a reversed recovery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aversion forms a social bargain: one group addresses those who hate the delivery, promises compliance in only part of the affair, and hides the rest. Outward work can therefore be coordinated and substantial while being internally partitioned against the governing instruction.

activation_trace.role: Negotiated exchange concerning an affair supplies the coalition's spoken bargain.
Repugnance identifies the social partner around whom the bargain forms.
Directed delivery supplies the shared object being selectively resisted.
Agreement and mutual compliance supply the promised alignment between groups.
Partition into only one part supplies selective rather than whole obedience.
The affair as an organized state of action supplies what is being partitioned.
Concealment in the interior supplies the hidden remainder behind outward compliance.
Interpersonal transaction supplies a work-form that can be socially coordinated yet compromised.
Inflated outward form supplies substantial-looking cooperation whose interior is not viable.

structural_cues: 47:26 repeats the focus verse's aversion and delivery language but adds direct address, partial compliance, and concealed content.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a promise to the aversion group, partial obedience, and secrecy; I infer that partitioned compliance contaminates the resulting cooperative work. A live alternative is a tactical promise whose speakers do not share every motive of those addressed.

changed_reading.before: Aversion is an individual's private dislike that nullifies private deeds.
changed_reading.after: Aversion can organize a network of selective compliance, producing impressive joint work whose hidden partition makes it nonviable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated collapse formula is expanded into a two-direction vector: they actively follow what produces displeasure and actively reject abundant divine approval. Collapse follows not bare absence but sustained movement toward one pole and away from the other.

activation_trace.role: Following behind a guide supplies positive pursuit rather than passive omission.
Displeasure opposed to approval supplies the pole that their pursuit serves.
Repugnance supplies active movement away from the opposed pole.
Abundant or sought approval supplies the rejected positive pole.
The split target's obedience, love, and guarantee image adds an affiliative scope to what is rejected.
Collapse supplies the endpoint of the sustained directional choice.
Purposeful acts are the outputs shaped by that preference vector.

structural_cues: 47:28 repeats aversion, collapse, and works from the focus verse while adding pursuit of displeasure and rejection of approval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit pursuit and rejection around opposed affective poles; I infer that the direction of desire organizes the fate of action. The alternative is that pursuit and aversion are evidentiary labels while collapse remains an independent judgement.

changed_reading.after: Dislike is half of a sustained preference vector that actively organizes works toward displeasure and away from approval.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hidden interior condition becomes legible through marks, slanted speech, and tested reports. Collapse can therefore be diagnostic as well as destructive: pressure reveals that outward work lacked a viable interior before its failure became visible.

activation_trace.role: Diminished clarity and darkening supply a concealed interior defect.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies exposure of that defect.
Recognition by an effect or sign supplies legibility of the hidden condition.
A visible mark indicating condition supplies the external diagnostic surface.
The slant of speech toward its implication supplies a behavioral leak from the interior.
Knowledge through report and the inside of an affair supplies testing of what lies behind outward claims.
Terminal swelling supplies latent nonviability that becomes visible under pressure.

structural_cues: The ض غ ن occurrence at 47:29 word 11 names the hidden content but has no branch inventory, so it supports only the reveal sequence.
47:29-31 moves from concealed interior content to marks and tone, then to testing persons and reports.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, exposure, marks, tone, and testing; I infer that collapse manifests a preexisting lack of viability. The alternative is that these tests concern later identification and do not explain the earlier collapse formula.

changed_reading.before: God's act makes sound-looking works vanish without disclosing why they failed.
changed_reading.after: Pressure makes the works' concealed nonviability legible before or as they collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opposition tries to fracture from and overpower the messenger, yet explicitly cannot diminish God; the announced collapse lands on the opponents' own works. The next address tells believers not to invalidate their works, preserving two live readings at once: divine judgement causes collapse, and human disobedience is a preventable route into it.

activation_trace.role: A group split open by disagreement supplies social rupture from the messenger.
The split target's contest for mastery supplies attempted opposition rather than mere separation.
Messenger and message supply the proximal object against which the rupture is enacted.
Harm as loss opposed to benefit supplies the explicitly negated effect on God.
Collapse supplies the effect redirected onto the opponents' own output.
Their intentional acts supply the actual site of loss.
Yielding obedience supplies the preventable human alternative.
Actively removing a thing's validity supplies human-facing invalidation language.
Purposeful acts are again the protected or endangered object.

structural_cues: 47:32 explicitly negates harm to God and places future collapse on their works; 47:33 immediately commands another audience not to invalidate its works.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed outward harm, recoil onto works, obedience, and a prohibition on invalidation; I infer a preventable route into a divinely stated consequence. The live alternatives remain distinct: direct divine cancellation, human self-nullification, or a warning where the human act only occasions the divine verdict.

changed_reading.before: God externally erases deeds, with no human agency question.
changed_reading.after: The attempted harm cannot reach God and recoils onto work, while the adjacent warning keeps human preventability beside divine causation without resolving the tension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Refusing weakness and premature peace is followed by assurance that works will not be deprived, then by the promise of their wages. Collapsed work can therefore be read as a claim rendered nonpayable, while steadfast work is retained without deduction.

activation_trace.role: Weakening of force and resolve supplies the condition that threatens continued work.
Peace opposed to war supplies the concrete premature exit being refused in this sequence.
A deduction that strips a right or work supplies the explicitly denied loss.
Work's wage and the worker's provision supply the claim-like value retained in action.
Compensation for work supplies the payable endpoint of retained action.
A claim left without requital supplies the juridical edge of nonpayable work.

structural_cues: 47:35-36 moves from no deprivation of works directly to receipt of wages, creating an explicit conservation contrast with the focus collapse.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied deduction and work-compensation; I infer a retained-claim mechanism for viable deeds. The alternative is that these are broad assurances of reward without a formal account or claim structure.

changed_reading.before: Collapsed deeds cease to exist in an undifferentiated way.
changed_reading.after: Collapsed deeds lose enforceable or payable value, whereas steadfast deeds remain an undiminished claim carried through to compensation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final call treats withholding as self-directed loss: the source is independent, recipients are needy, and a refusing group can be replaced by another that rises into its place. Work collapse need not impede the larger purpose; it can remove current actors from productive succession.

activation_trace.role: Property going out in expenditure supplies the demanded conversion of possession into action.
Withholding supplies refusal to perform that conversion.
The very self supplies the actual endpoint of withholding's loss.
Independence from need supplies the source's immunity to the actors' refusal.
Need and lack of means supply the recipients' dependence on participation.
One thing standing in another's place supplies replacement of failed actors.
Standing in for another supplies the successor group's functional role.
Holding an assigned work and standing over it supplies participation from which an actor can be displaced.

structural_cues: 47:38 ends the surah with a call to act, repeated withholding, self-directed loss, divine independence, human need, and replacement by another group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies expenditure, withholding, self-loss, independence, need, and replacement; I infer that nullified work removes actors without frustrating the larger purpose. The alternative is a future communal warning unrelated to the mechanics of 47:9's past-tense collapse.

changed_reading.before: Their deed-loss is a loss to the project they opposed.
changed_reading.after: Their refusal costs themselves their productive place; the larger work can continue through actors who stand in for them.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a moral-action statement through veterinary and digestive materiality. It remains anchored in the focus verb's harmful-forage swelling, the focus delivery-as-provision branch, and the context sequence of cattle-like eating, repellent drink, and severed bowels. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for deceptive nourishment and terminal output, never as a lexical translation or a claim of physical illness.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins aversion, delivered provision, harmful-forage collapse, and purposeful works.

activation_trace.role: Repellent reception supplies refusal of what should nourish.
Prepared provision for a recipient supplies the offered nourishment.
Livestock bloat from harmful forage supplies intake that enlarges while bringing near-ruin.
Taking food into the body supplies the ingestion step of the cascade.
Grazing livestock supply the exact animal domain activated by the collapse branch.
Water consumed with aversion fuses drinking and repugnance inside the material analogy.
Internal cramping and interruption supply the terminal break after bad intake.
The bowel supplies the interior site where deceptive nourishment becomes visible as destruction.

changed_reading.before: Cancellation is a clean bookkeeping deletion.
changed_reading.after: The delivered provision enters a cattle-like appetite and yields swollen, internally rupturing work: apparent feeding becomes terminal non-nourishment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it treats works as a productive water installation rather than a ledger. It remains anchored in the focus branch where a well loses water irreversibly and is sharpened by the context's flowing rivers and water. Downstream prose should mark it as an ecological infrastructure analogy and avoid asserting that the delivered object literally means rain here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus verb can image a well whose water is gone, while descent can image rain and works can image hand-built production.

activation_trace.role: Rain-like descent supplies replenishment from above.
A well whose water departs and does not return supplies a standing structure stripped of yield.
Hand-workers who dig and build supply the constructed productive source.
A river cutting earth with flowing water supplies the context's abundant counter-image.
Water itself supplies the medium whose presence or withdrawal determines yield.

changed_reading.after: The made structure can remain visible while its replenishing water is gone, so nullification is loss of sustainable yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it imports the focus verb's wasted-blood branch into the status of deeds. It remains anchored by the nearby slain persons whose works are explicitly protected from loss, producing a precise juridical contrast between a claim preserved and one left without requital. Downstream prose should call this a claim analogy and must not equate deeds with blood or identify a historical victim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus collapse verb includes blood left without requital, and its direct object is purposeful works.

activation_trace.role: Blood left without vengeance or compensation supplies a valid claim rendered non-actionable.
Actual killing supplies the context that makes the blood-claim image newly audible.
An object left to loss supplies the explicitly denied fate of the slain persons' works.
Purposeful deeds are the protected object in the nearby killing sequence.

changed_reading.before: Nullified work is merely omitted from reward.
changed_reading.after: Nullified work can be heard as a valid-looking claim made legally inert, in contrast to the slain whose works are not allowed to go unrequited.

strongest_changes: The focus became a reception mechanism with opposite repair and collapse branches, not an isolated penalty attached after dislike.
Aversion moved from private feeling to an action-threshold failure and then to a social system of selective obedience and concealed coordination.
The sequence after clarified guidance activated relapse: already-forming work can reopen like a wound rather than simply never exist.
The no-harm statement and the prohibition on invalidating one's works preserve a live tension between divine cancellation, human self-nullification, and preventable occasion.
Material branches kept three contained readings alive: toxic forage, a dry productive well, and a claim left without requital.
summary.what_was_special: The surah repeatedly reuses the focus roots and their outcome formula while changing the mechanism around them: repair, footing, appetite, hearing, resolve, coalition, exposure, non-harm, compensation, and replacement. That density made several incompatible but anchored readings coexist without requiring a final choice.
remaining_uncertainties: The harmful-forage, dry-well, wound-relapse, and wasted-blood branches may be productive analogies rather than intended semantic layers in this occurrence.
The relation between divine causation in collapse and human agency in not invalidating work remains deliberately unresolved.
The context does not require every described group or interior state to belong to the same actors, so cross-ayah mechanisms remain abductive.
The ض غ ن occurrences lack a branch inventory in the packet and therefore support only sequence structure, not a branch citation or invented branch reading.
